resolved_findings.issue: Paging/segmentation/segmented-paging distinctions and access counts were scattered
resolved_findings.resolution: Common dimensions restored; 2/2/3 accesses explicitly require single-level paging, main-memory tables, no cache hit/fault/permission violation

resolved_findings.issue: File allocation comparison omitted overhead and cache assumptions
resolved_findings.resolution: Adds zero-based block indexing, path-wide uncached data/index blocks, no saved intermediate block number, resident FAT, explicit h+1 index path and residual block slack

resolved_findings.issue: Moving segmented-paging prose into a table initially dropped its checks
resolved_findings.resolution: Checks segment identity/permissions and per-segment page-table length; byte-level segment limit is checked when supplied, without assuming absent hardware fields

resolved_findings.issue: Sorting table combined distinct dimensions and best-case implementations
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate best/average/worst/space/stability columns; binary-insertion full search, bubble early stop, merge implementation, heap equal-key exception and counting/radix space assumptions are explicit

resolved_findings.issue: B-tree mechanism needed a compact order-5 example
resolved_findings.resolution: Verified 16 to17 keys, leaf split then root split, 5 keys to2/promote1/2, six children to3/3, borrowing, cascading merge and root height reduction; temporary violations explicitly marked

resolved_findings.issue: LR/RL double rotations omitted the first rotation state
resolved_findings.resolution: All four rotation cases preserve exact key sets/inorder, nonempty transferred subtrees and computed balance factors; pre-insertion height3, temporary4, final3

resolved_findings.issue: Multi-key labels initially crossed B-tree node boundaries
resolved_findings.resolution: Actual regenerated DS15/DS20 PNGs now contain each key in its node and distinguish neighboring leaves; this is a node-membership mechanism fix, not final-page typesetting acceptance

resolved_findings.issue: B+ comparison could conflate leaf records and index-path I/O
resolved_findings.resolution: Leaf keys plus record/record-pointer convention explicit; h counts index pages, external record I/O separately; hash average complexity keeps distribution/load conditions

resolved_findings.issue: Protocol field explanations lacked textbook header placement
resolved_findings.resolution: Independently checked actual IPv4/TCP/UDP/Ethernet images against original headers: field order, bit widths, units, options/padding, checksum scopes and MAC boundaries match

resolved_findings.issue: Same-named lengths/checksums and frame/wire-cycle boundaries required explicit conditions
resolved_findings.resolution: 4B IHL/TCP offsets,8B fragment offset, UDP header-inclusive length, checksum-only pseudoheaders, IPv4 zero-checksum semantics and Ethernet14/64-1518/672-bit-cycle conditions remain distinct

resolved_findings.issue: Comparisons could lose service endpoints or model conditions
resolved_findings.resolution: ARQ windows/ACK conventions and textbook Wr<=Ws, medium/full-duplex assumptions, routing information versus carrier, TCP versus UDP, rwnd/cwnd/inflight and ideal HTTP dependency timeline reviewed on common dimensions; final CN04 formula-only fix reread
